items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Dick, we had a, we had boxes full of letters, had, used to get caught from Fosby when he was on the road with Crosby, you know.

ctx.x: Adrian Gosley. Adrian Gosley. And Young Huxon.

Yeah, Huxon, that's right. He went on to California, never to come back. Never to see him anymore. What was his first name? Well, D.W. Oh, gotta tell you about D.W. He used to be on the road with Vans, see. In fact, he played with Dick Mackie, I believe, along the Gulf Coast once. D.W. Every time he'd go out on the road, see, when he'd get back in town, he'd call me up and say, I'm back in town, huh? He'd say, can you sell my drums for me? You know? Say, oh man, I said, you wouldn't want to sell your drums. I…
